g.text: Recorded CPU coverage: 36/36 real codecs with a complete case
L: bitwise; ABS: bounded absolute error; E: empirical quality; ref: raw-store.
Different groups have different requested inputs. Counts describe recorded coverage, not speed or a universal domain guarantee.
Composite cases are grouped by their primary route codec; every component binding remains in the trace.
Historical errors/unavailability remain in the history figure; integer-affine routes are distinct schemes.
